name: Kostely v Česku (Churches in Czechia)
title: Kostely v Česku (Churches in Czechia)
description: Comprehensive list of churches, chapels, basilicas, and cathedrals in the Czech Republic, sourced from cs.wikipedia via recursive category traversal of Kategorie:Kostely v Česku and ~50 related subcategories covering all 14 Czech regions (Praha + 13 kraj), 8 Roman Catholic dioceses, denominations (Catholic, Protestant, Orthodox, Hussite), architectural styles (Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance, Baroque, Classicist, Neo-Gothic, Pseudo-Gothic), and historical/ruined forms. Each record enriched with Wikidata multilingual labels (36 languages), descriptions (5 langs), claims (country, location, religion, dedicated_to, diocese, architect, architectural style, materials, inception/consecration/dissolution dates), geo-coordinates, Wikimedia Commons image URL, ÚSKP heritage register ID, and Wikipedia sitelinks (37 wikis).

meta.title: Kostely v Česku (Churches in Czechia) - Stáhnout zdarma
meta.description: Comprehensive list of churches, chapels, basilicas, and cathedrals in the Czech Republic, sourced from cs.wikipedia via recursive category traversal of Kategorie:Kostely v Česku and ~50 related subcategories covering all 14 Czech regions (Praha + 13 kraj), 8 Roman Catholic dioceses, denominations (Catholic, Protestant, Orthodox, Hussite), architectural styles (Romanesque, Gothic, Renaissance, Baroque, Classicist, Neo-Gothic, Pseudo-Gothic), and historical/ruined forms. Each record enriched with Wikidata multilingual labels (36 languages), descriptions (5 langs), claims (country, location, religion, dedicated_to, diocese, architect, architectural style, materials, inception/consecration/dissolution dates), geo-coordinates, Wikimedia Commons image URL, ÚSKP heritage register ID, and Wikipedia sitelinks (37 wikis). Obsahuje 3139 záznamů. Stáhnout ve formátech Excel, CSV, PDF.
